Definition: Paltiel, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Paltiel names two men. The first is the prince of Issachar who helps divide the land under Moses and Eleazar, and the second is the husband of Michal, Saul's daughter, from whom Abner takes her back to give to David.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Paltiels show both sides of a name: one divides the land in peace, the other loses his wife to a king's politics, and God records them both.
RelatedPeople: Paltiel, Son of Azzan; King David
